review.reviewer: independent PH-283 settlement-coverage reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER 1 - `remaining` omits refunded/returned coverage: `_item_bundle` computes `remaining = item.gross_cents - cleared - offset` and `_item_projection`/summary expose `max(0, remaining)`, while the Lead/spec formula is gross - active cleared - offset(0) - refunded - returned. The gold test even asserts `remaining_cents == gross - 30000` after a 5000 refund, so the test locks in the wrong value; `remaining_mismatch` also compares against the model's gross-cleared value and would misreport once the formula is corrected. Fix: subtract the item's refunded/returned coverage in the derived remaining (and in summary), keep offset=0, update the gold/derived-value tests to assert the formula, and make remaining_mismatch compare the corrected remaining.

BLOCKER 2 - duplicate-active detection ignores the actual duplicate key: `_item_issues` builds `seen` with `(open_item_id, cash_transaction_id, cleared_cents, occurred_on)`. Two active clearance rows for the same open item and cash transaction but different amounts or occurred_on are not counted as duplicates, so `clearance_duplicate_active` is not reported for a real duplicate-reference tamper. Fix: key by `(open_item_id, cash_transaction_id)` (or the canonical clearance identity) and add a regression with a second active row that differs only in amount/date.

PASSED CHECKS: read-only purity (no writes/audit/receipt/migration; service uses check_module=False for history), no Offset table read and offset_cents=0/offset_implemented=false, append-only INSERT-based counterexamples, OpenItem gross/active Clearance/refund/return coverage/posted cash checks, 200-item cap, cross-org/missing/not-posted/direction/ref-mismatch/cash_coverage_over_gross issue codes, owner/finance/auditor company scope, pm visible_projects with manager=member, member denied, history_read routes (GET readable after module disable), no verify_integrity change, 13 files all inside PH-283 allowed_paths; task in_review, manifest=PH-283. deviations: Offset: PH-241 is in_review and not a dependency; the snapshot never reads the Offset table, reports offset_cents=0 and offset_implemented=false, and does not invent an offset fact, per the spec.

Cross-project reference checks: cash facts (CashTransaction/FundingAccount/Refund/BankReturn) carry no project attribution, so only cross-organization / missing / non-posted / direction / stale-ref clearance-cash issues are derivable; a true cross-project cash-vs-open-item reference cannot be expressed in the current schema and is disclosed for a future contract.

Refund/return coverage is derived directly from the Refund/BankReturn models rather than calling cash.refund_coverage_for_cash, because the latter gates on the cash module being enabled; this keeps settlement/cash history readable when either module is disabled (spec requirement) while still deriving from the same owner facts.

pm scope: pm reads only open items of visible_projects where manager=member (and a project filter must be a managed project); the snapshot scope is labelled managed_projects. owner/finance/auditor see company scope.

Counterexamples are append-only compatible: extra active Clearance/duplicate rows are INSERTed, never UPDATE/DELETE, so the tests behave identically on SQLite and PostgreSQL append-only triggers; no historical row is mutated.

remaining is server-derived as gross - active cleared - offset(0) - refunded/returned coverage (summary and per-item share the formula); remaining_mismatch adjusts the model's refund-agnostic remaining_cents by subtracting refunded/returned before comparing with the new derived value, so a refund does not create a false mismatch. The duplicate_active branch uses the canonical (open item, cash fact) identity, so a second active clearance with a different amount or occurred_on is still reported; both counterexamples are append-only INSERTs.
The read path writes no generic audit (the spec made it optional), keeping the snapshot side-effect free; no verify_integrity assertion is changed or added.

Single worker owns the whole write set (settlement coverage service/views/template/domain metadata, delivery urls, two test files, governance); no parallel slice writes these files; independent review is pending.

Reviewer round-1 fixes: remaining now deducts refunded/returned coverage (gold test updated to gross - cleared - refunded/returned), and clearance_duplicate_active keys on the canonical (open_item, cash_transaction) identity instead of (amount, occurred_on), with an added different-amount/date append-only counterexample.
